The '''Nuon e Safyd sector''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Reidi Artom I system|Reidi Artom I]] and [[T'surr system/Legends|T'surr systems]]. The former contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artom]], which was named after its discoverer, the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Reidi Artom]], while the latter was the site of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[T'surr]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[T'surr (species)|same name]].

==Description==
The Nuon e Safyd [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Circarpous sector]] and [[Cyrillian Protectorate/Legends|Cyrillian Protectorate]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] and the [[Ombakond sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. [[Spinward]], the Nuon e Safyd formed a four-way border with the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian]], [[Hocatar sector/Legends|Hocatar]], and [[Authala sector/Legends|Authala sectors]], and the southeastern portion of the sector was adjacent to the [[Indra-su-Mar sector/Legends|Indra-su-Mar sector]] and the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]].<ref name="Expansion" />

==Locations==
[[File:Tsurr-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Nuon e Safyd sector contained the planet T'surr.]]
The Nuon e Safyd sector contained the [[Reidi Artom I system|Reidi Artom I]] and [[T'surr system/Legends|T'surr systems]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The former contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artom]],<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the latter was the site of the [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] and windswept high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[T'surr]], which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a weak [[Star/Legends|sun]]. T'surr was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAA" /> Although the [[Gender/Legends|males]] were the dominant T'surr gender on their homeworld,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|266|T'surr}}</ref> the females had the ultimate authority in T'surr homes, making many of the males anxious to leave their home planet for the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="UAA" /> While T'surr could already be found off-world by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="Aflame1">[[Knight Errant 1|''Knight Errant'' 1]]</ref> the species had no representation in either the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or in [[New Republic Senate/Legends|that]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] due to the perceived nature of the T'surr as aggressive [[Death/Legends|killers]].<ref name="UAA" />

By [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' dates [[Reidi Artom]]'s rediscovery and naming of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Reidi Artom VI system]] to 200 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which corresponds to [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Since the ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' also establishes that the [[Reidi Artom I system]] was discovered before Reidi Artom VI, the former's discovery must have taken place at some point by that date.</ref> Artom became the first discovery of [[Reidi Artom]], a Republic [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who was dispatched to the Expansion Region to survey any [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] missed by previous explorers.<ref name="LFCG" /> Artom had a penchant for naming systems she discovered after<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040115manifesto|text=Reidi Artom's Expansion Manifesto}}</ref> her own name<ref name="LFCG" /> or variations thereof instead of adhering to the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standard of naming a system after its star or central planet.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nuon e Safyd sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was illustrated on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares O-12 and P-12.<ref name="Expansion" />
